questions.question: Viscosity an important property in food processing operations. Justify
questions.solution_html:
• Viscosity is an important property in food processing operations. Justify.
  • Viscosity represents the resistance of a fluid to flow. It plays a critical role in food processing
  • as it affects pumping, mixing, heat transfer, and texture. High viscosity materials require
  • more energy for processing and influence product quality.
questions.final_answer: more energy for processing and influence product quality

questions.question: Differentiate between coarse crushing and fine grinding.
questions.solution_html:
• Coarse crushing reduces materials into relatively larger fragments, whereas fine grinding
  • produces very small and uniform particles with increased surface area. Grinding requires
  • higher energy compared to crushing.
questions.final_answer: higher energy compared to crushing

questions.question: What happens to water during freezing?
questions.solution_html:
• During freezing, water is converted into ice crystals. This process leads to expansion in
  • volume and reduction in water activity. Large ice crystals may damage cellular structures in
  • food.
questions.final_answer: food

questions.question: Comment on lyophilization.
questions.solution_html:
• Comment on lyophilization.

  • structure.

questions.question: State the methods to reduce water activity in foods.
questions.solution_html:
• Water activity in foods can be reduced by drying, addition of solutes such as salt or sugar
  • freezing, and concentration. These methods inhibit microbial growth and enhance
  • preservation.
questions.final_answer: preservation

questions.question: Describe the construction and working of a scraped surface heat exchanger.
questions.solution_html:
• A scraped surface heat exchanger consists of a cylindrical shell with a rotating shaft fitted
  • with blades. The blades continuously scrape the inner surface to prevent fouling and ensure
  • efficient heat transfer. It is widely used for viscous and heat sensitive food products.
questions.final_answer: efficient heat transfer. It is widely used for viscous and heat sensitive food products
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe surface tension and explain its importance in food processing / operations.
questions.solution_html:
• Surface tension is the force acting at the surface of a liquid due to cohesive forces between
  • molecules. It plays a significant role in emulsification, foaming, droplet formation, and
  • stability of food systems.
questions.final_answer: stability of food systems
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Write a short note on equipments used for size reduction of liquid foods.
questions.solution_html:
• Equipments such as homogenizers and colloid mills are used for size reduction of liquid
  • foods. These devices reduce particle size, improve texture, and enhance stability of
  • emulsions.
questions.final_answer: emulsions
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain rotary pumps.
questions.solution_html:
• Rotary pumps are positive displacement pumps that use rotating components to move fluids.
  • They are suitable for handling viscous and shear sensitive food materials and provide a steady
  • flow.

questions.question: Differentiate First and Second Laws of Thermodynamics.
questions.solution_html:
• The first law states that energy cannot be created or destroyed but can be transformed from
  • one form to another. The second law states that heat flows from a higher temperature to a
  • lower temperature and that entropy of an isolated system increases.

questions.solution_html:

  • body. It influences the efficiency of heat transfer in processes such as baking and drying.

questions.question: Explain U-tube manometer.
questions.solution_html:
• A U-tube manometer is a device used to measure pressure differences using a liquid column.
  • The difference in liquid levels in the two arms indicates the pressure difference.
questions.final_answer: A U-tube manometer is a device used to measure pressure differences using a liquid column

questions.question: Compare pasteurization and sterilization based on thermodynamic principles.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare pasteurization and sterilization based on thermodynamic principles.
  • Pasteurization involves heating food to moderate temperatures to destroy pathogenic
  • microorganisms, whereas sterilization involves higher temperatures to eliminate all
  • microorganisms including spores. Sterilization requires greater energy input.
  • Long Essay Questions

questions.question: Explain basic drying process with drying rate curve and stages.
questions.solution_html:
• Drying is the process of removing moisture from food using heat. The drying rate curve
  • consists of three stages: initial constant rate period, falling rate period, and final equilibrium
  • stage. Moisture removal initially occurs rapidly and then decreases as bound water remains.
questions.final_answer: stage. Moisture removal initially occurs rapidly and then decreases as bound water remains
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the concepts of internal energy and enthalpy and explain their / significance in food processing operations.
questions.solution_html:

  • energy of molecules. Enthalpy is the total heat content of a system and is given by H = U +

questions.final_answer: PV. These concepts are important in designing heating and cooling processes

questions.question: Compare natural convection and forced convection with respect to mechanism, / heat transfer coefficient, and applications in food processing.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare natural convection and forced convection with respect to mechanism, heat
  • transfer coefficient, and applications in food processing.
  • Natural convection occurs due to density differences caused by temperature variation
  • whereas forced convection involves external forces such as pumps or fans. Forced convection
  • has a higher heat transfer coefficient and is widely used in industrial processes.
questions.final_answer: has a higher heat transfer coefficient and is widely used in industrial processes
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

  • used in fluid flow analysis.
